feed.title: Protein Pints’ Michigan founders expand into new ice cream bars
feed.summary: Michigan-based Protein Pints, founded by Michael Meadow and Paul Reiss, is expanding its product line with new Protein Pops, now available at Target and Kroger stores across the state. These ice cream bars, containing 10 grams of protein and 180-190 calories each, were developed based on extensive consumer feedback and have already seen significant success with an online sell-out. The company, which started with protein ice cream pints, aims to attract new customers to the ice cream category while continuing to grow its original product line.

feed.title: Is Now the Time to Bet on Intel’s (INTC) Server CPU Comeback and AI Ambitions?
feed.summary: Intel (INTC) is advancing its semiconductor manufacturing with its 18A process, expanding foundry operations, and developing new AI-focused processors. The company's stake in Altera and efforts to restore its competitive edge in conventional server CPUs and AI inference workloads present growth opportunities. However, supply chain bottlenecks and factory capacity constraints pose challenges, though institutional sentiment remains encouraging.

feed.title: NetApp's unified storage paves the way for agents
feed.summary: NetApp is positioning its unified storage solutions as crucial for managing the data demands of AI, including training, RAG, inference, and agentic workloads. The company aims to address data fragmentation and operational complexity, allowing enterprises to integrate AI without creating new data silos. The upcoming NetApp INSIGHT event, covered by theCUBE, will focus on NetApp's strategy for building an AI-ready enterprise data foundation and supporting data mobility.

feed.title: US FDA approves AbbVie's drug for Parkinson's disease
feed.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved AbbVie's new drug, tavapadon (brand name Juvmo), for Parkinson's disease in adults. This once-a-day pill aims to help manage the long-term brain condition that affects movement control. AbbVie acquired the rights to tavapadon through its 2023 acquisition of Cerevel Therapeutics.

feed.title: Strive's preferred stock funds $117M Bitcoin buys, now holding 25,000 BTC via innovative equity method.
feed.summary: Strive, Inc. has utilized its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock (SATA) to acquire Bitcoin, accumulating approximately 25,000 BTC worth over $145 million since November 2025. This innovative equity method allows Strive to fund Bitcoin purchases without incurring debt or significant dilution, offering a new model for Bitcoin treasury management. The company has raised over $1 billion in notional value through this strategy.

feed.title: Starbucks shutters 2 Charlotte stores as part of 250-location closure wave
feed.summary: Starbucks is closing two locations in Charlotte, North Carolina this weekend, as part of a larger plan by CEO Brian Niccol to close 250 stores across North America. These closures represent about 1% of Starbucks' North American footprint. This news follows other recent closures of food and drink establishments in the Charlotte area.

feed.title: NetApp Bets On Peak:AIO Acquisition To Provide New Performance Firepower In AI Data Battle
feed.summary: NetApp is acquiring Peak:AIO to enhance its AI and high-performance computing infrastructure, leveraging Peak:AIO's parallel NFS technology. This acquisition aims to address the growing demand for massive data workloads and stringent performance requirements in enterprise AI factories. The integration of Peak:AIO's advanced metadata architecture and parallel file systems is expected to provide NetApp with new capabilities for ultra-fast, parallel access to large datasets, thereby strengthening its competitive position in the AI and HPC markets.

feed.title: TJX CEO: Distribution model will help weather El Niño
feed.summary: TJX Companies' CEO Ernie Herrman stated that the retailer's warehouse distribution model will help it navigate weather-related events like El Niño. Unlike traditional retailers, TJX can hold inventory in its warehouses and distribute it based on real-time data and weather patterns, offering greater control over its supply chain. This "hold and flow" model allows the off-price retailer to react strategically to environmental changes and customer demand.

feed.summary: Darden Restaurants (DRI) shares fell 3.6% after its fiscal first-quarter report, primarily due to slower-than-expected Olive Garden growth and revenue slightly missing expectations, despite overall sales growth and reaffirmed full-year guidance. feed.title: Oklo’s Isotope Test Reactor achieves criticality
feed.summary: Oklo's Groves Isotope Test Reactor has achieved criticality, becoming the fifth Department of Energy-authorized reactor to do so. This significant milestone was reached in Lockhart, Texas, in less than a year from a greenfield site, setting a new benchmark for advanced nuclear deployment. The project is part of Oklo Isotopes' broader strategy to build domestic isotope production facilities for various applications, including health care and national security.
